abstract: A case of multiple malignancies (squamous cell carcinoma and sarcoma) arising in an ovarian dermoid cyst of a 75-year-old woman is reported: this appears, to the best of our knowledge, to be the first well documented example of such a complex tumor. The two malignant components had a well-demarcated boundary except for at their junction, a feature more indicative of a collision tumor rather than carcinosarcoma of the ovary. The solid sarcomatous portion displayed a prominently myxoid and pleomorphic appearance with a focal whorling and storiform pattern, the features considered to be compatible with the myxoid varient of malignant fibrous histiocytoma recently defined by Weiss and Enzinger. The patient is alive and well 21 months after surgery.
abstract_ja: 75歳女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた、扁平上皮癌と肉腫という多重悪性腫瘍の症例を報告する。知る限り、このような複合腫瘍の十分に記録された最初の例と思われる。2つの悪性成分は接合部を除いて明瞭な境界を示し、卵巣の癌肉腫よりも衝突腫瘍を示唆する特徴であった。肉腫性部分は、WeissとEnzingerが最近定義した悪性線維性組織球腫の粘液型に適合する粘液様かつ多形性の外観を示し、焦点性の渦巻状・束状パターンを伴っていた。患者は手術から21か月後も生存し、良好な状態である。
